cohort: The study included 18,793 deliveries at Niloufer Hospital between June 2022 and May 2024, comprising mothers and their newborns.
finding: The incidence rate of congenital anomalies was 12.77 per 1,000 deliveries, with maternal age (>35 years), education level, occupation, smoking, comorbidities (diabetes, hypertension), and gestational age significantly influencing the occurrence of anomalies.
